questions.question: When (77⁷⁷ + 77) is divided by 78, the remainder is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(77⁷⁷ + 77) ÷ 78

**Formula:**

(x³ + y³) = (x + y) (x² - xy + y²)

(xⁿ + yⁿ) = (x + y) ............

Where n is an odd number

**Calculation:**

(7777 + 77) ÷ 78

⇒ [(7777 + 1) + 76]/78

⇒ [(7777 + 1)/78 + 76/78

⇒ [(7777 + 1⁷⁷)/78 + 76/78

Form the give formula we can say (7777 + 1⁷⁷) is divisible by 78.

∴ Remainder = 76.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72be33799c08d3322a2907949d25e7543e352bc7880a277f6efed7f62d7c04b.png] 

**Calculation:**

According to the question, we have

When 77 is divided by 78, the remainder will be (- 1)

Using remainder theorem

 [(7777 + 77)/78

⇒ [(-1)⁷⁷ + (-1)]/78

⇒ (- 1 - 1)/78

⇒ (- 2)/78

⇒ 76

**∴ The reminder is 76.**

questions.question: If x + y + z = 10, x³ + y³ + z³ = 75 and xyz = 15, then find the value of x² + y² + z² – xy – yz – zx
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x + y + z = 10, (x³ + y³ + z³) = 75 and xyz = 15

**Formula:**

(x³ + y³ + z³ - 3xyz) = (x + y + z) (x² + y² + z² - xy - yz - zx)

**Calculation:**

According to the given formula

(x3 + y3 + z3 - 3xyz) = (x + y + z) (x2 + y2 + z2 - xy - yz - zx)

⇒ 75 - 3 × 15 = 10 × (x2 + y2 + z2 - xy - yz - zx)

⇒ 75 - 45 = 10 × (x2 + y2 + z2 - xy - yz - zx)

⇒ (x2 + y2 + z2 - xy - yz - zx) = 30/10 

∴ x2 + y2 + z2 - xy - yz - zx = 3

questions.question: Length and breadth of rectangular field are in the ratio 5 ∶ 2. If the perimeter of the field is 238 m. Find the length of the field.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of length and breadth of the rectangular field = 5 : 2.

Perimeter of the rectangular field = 238 m.

**Formula:**

Perimeter of the rectangle = 2(l + b)

**Calculation:**

Ratio of length and breadth of the rectangular field = 5x : 2x

According to the question

2 × (5x + 2x) = 238

⇒ 2 × 7x = 238

⇒ x = 238/14

⇒ x = 17 m

∴ Length of the field = 5 × 17 = 85 m.

questions.question: Mohan offers to sell his articles at a discount of 20%, but he marks his articles by increasing the price of each by 35%. What percentage would his gain be?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Discount = 20%

MP is more than CP by 35%

**Formula:**

Profit = SP – CP

Profit % = (Profit/CP) × 100

**Calculation:**

Let CP of the articles be Rs. 100

MP of the articles = 100 × (135/100) = Rs. 135

Now,

SP of the articles = 135 × (80/100) = Rs. 108

Profit = Rs. 108 - Rs. 100 = Rs. 8

∴ Profit percentage = (8/100) × 100 = 8%

**Calculation:**

In ΔLMN

Area of right-angled ΔLMN = (1/2) × r × r

questions.question: The average of the runs of a cricket player in 20 matches is 35. If the average of the first 12 matches is 45, find the average of the last 8 matches.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average runs of player in 20 matches = 35

Average runs of player in first 12 matches = 45

**Formula:**

Average = (Sum of all observations)/(Total number of all observations)

**Calculation:**

Sum of runs of player in 20 matches = 35 × 20 = 700

Sum of runs of player in first 12 matches = 12 × 45 = 540

Sum of runs of player in last 8 matches = 700 - 540 = 160

∴ Average runs of player in last 8 matches = 160/8 = 20 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

REMAING matches Average

= common average - [(higher avg - avg) x no of player (high avg)]\remaing player

= 35 - [(45 - 30)12]/8 = 35 - (120/8) =35 -15 =20

questions.question: 30 men working 8 hours per day can dig a pond in 16 days. By working how many hours per day can 32 men dig the same pond in 20 days?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

30 men working 8 hours per day can dig a pond in = 16 days

**Formula:**

M₁ × T₁ × D₁ = M₂ × T₂ × D₂

**Calculation:**

M₁ = 30 men, T₁ = 8 hrs, D₁ = 16 days, M₂ = 32 men, D₂ = 20 days

According to the formula

30 × 8 × 16 = 32 × T₂ × 20

⇒ T₂ = (30 × 8 × 16)/(32 × 20)

∴ T₂ = 6 hrs.

questions.question:
In the given figure, O is the centre of the circle. Its two chords AB and CD intersect each other at the point P within the circle. If AB = 15 cm, PB = 9 cm, CP = 3 cm, then find the length of PD.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccc22754fea98c7c980d29dc5757c195e344e1a47c378533127ca5a38521ff3c.png]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two chords AB and CD intersect each other at the point P.

AB = 15 cm, PB = 9 cm and CP = 3 cm

**Formula:**

If two chords AB and CD intersect each other at point P inside the circle, then

AP × PB = CP × PD

**Calculation:**

AP = AB - PB 

⇒ AP = 15 - 9 = 6 cm

According to the formula

AP × PB = CP × PD

⇒ 6 × 9 = 3 × PD

⇒ PD = 54/3

∴ PD = 18

questions.question: Rs. 3,600 is divided between Seema, Komal and Rita, such that the ratios of the shares of Seema ∶ Komal = 1.5 ∶ 2 and Komal ∶ Rita = 2 ∶ 2.5. Find Rita's share.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total amount to be divided among Seema, Komal and Rita = Rs. 3600

Ratio of shares of Seema and Komal = 1.5 : 2

Ratio of shares of Komal and Rita = 2 : 2.5

**Calculation:**

Ratio of shares of Seema and Komal = 1.5x : 2 x 

Ratio of shares of Komal and Rita = 2x : 2.5x 

Ratio of shares of Seema, Komal and Rita = 1.5x : 2x : 2.5x

According to the question

1.5x + 2x + 2.5x = 3600

⇒ 6x = 3600

⇒ x = 3600/6

⇒ x = 600

∴ Share of Rita = 2.5 × 600 = Rs. 1,500

questions.question: If 4 cos²θ - 3 sin²θ + 2 = 0, then the value of tanθ is (where 0 ≤ θ < 90°)
questions.solution:
**Given**

4 cos2 θ - 3 sin2 θ + 2 = 0

**Formula:**

sin2θ + cos2θ = 1

tan2θ = sin2θ/cos2θ

**Calculation:**

4 cos2θ - 3 sin2θ + 2 = 0

⇒ 4 cos²θ - 3 (1 - cos²θ) + 2 = 0

⇒ 4 cos²θ - 3 + 3 cos²θ + 2 = 0

⇒ 7 cos²θ - 1 = 0

⇒ 7 cos²θ = 1

⇒ cos²θ = 1/7

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

⇒ sin²θ = 1 - 1/7

⇒ sin²θ = 6/7

Now,

tan²θ = sin²θ/cos²θ

⇒ tan²θ = (6/7)/(1/7)

⇒ tan²θ = 6

∴ tanθ = √6

questions.question: A runner is running at a speed of 40 km/h. If he runs at a speed of 30 km/h, then what will the decrease in the percentage of his speed be?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A runner is running at a speed = 40 km/hr

**Calculation:**

His speed in starting = 40 km/hr

His speed in last = 30 km/hr

He decreases his speed = 40 - 30 = 10 km/hr

∴ He decreases his speed (in %) = (10/40) × 100 = 25%

questions.question: If a - b = 4 and a³ - b³ = 88, then find the value of a² - b².
questions.solution:
**Given:**

a - b = 4 and a³ - b³ = 88

**Formula: **∴

(a³ - b³) = (a - b) (a² + b² + ab)

(a³ - b³) = (a - b) [(a - b)² + 3ab]

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

(a + b)(a - b) = a2 - b2

**Calculation:**

According to the formula

88 = 4 × (4² + 3ab)

⇒ 22 = 16 + 3ab

⇒ 3ab = 22 - 16

⇒ ab = 6/3

⇒ ab = 2

(a - b)² = a² + b² - 2ab

⇒ 4² = a² + b² - 2 × 2

⇒ a² + b² = 16 + 4 

⇒ a² + b² = 20

(a + b)² = 20 + 2 × 2

⇒ a + b = √24 = 2√6

Then (a + b)(a - b) = 2√6 × 4

⇒ 8√6 

∴ (a2 - b2) = 8√6
